text:
You have grown, root,

in the body, in the hands,

in me like a part

visible of myself,

in the feverish chest like a palpable dream.


Those dark fears

of the blood

suddenly left their lair,

my life, face to face, and the gleam

of an endless dream.

translation.title: You Have Grown, Root
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the root as a visible inner growth and a palpable dream.
